title: PrintProfile Command
description: Choose the document's print profile, or read the current one. A profile sets the poché fill and the colour and weight of the plan's line tiers and dashed lines; it drives the plan, the section sheets and the schedule rules. Stored in the document. The next layout_pack draws with it.

name.description: default: solid black poché, black lines. grey: grey poché, grey lines. hatch: hatched poché, lighter cut line. Omit to read the current profile.
